result:
result: The Windows `which` failure came from the test's env, not from missing Git folders in the code. I fixed the test and also added two more Git for Windows folders to the host search. `mise run build` and `mise run verify` both exit 0. I could not run the test on Windows, so the fix is not confirmed on the runner.

cause: The test calls the shell with an env of only `PATH=<Bun folder>` and `HOME`. On Windows `hostSearchFolders` reads `ProgramFiles` from that call env to find `Git\cmd`, and the test env had no `ProgramFiles`, so git was never registered. Pi passes the whole environment in real use, so real calls were not affected.
